summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K attaching two company announcements: that OCM Njord Holdings S.à r.l., an Oaktree/Brookfield-controlled vehicle, no longer holds any shares or voting rights in TORM as of October 6, 2026, and that Oaktree-designated director Christopher Boehringer stepped down from the board effective immediately. No price, stake percentage, premium or consideration is disclosed; the exit removes a long-standing financial-sponsor overhang and ends board representation. The Danish section 30 major-shareholder disclosure is the local equivalent of a US Schedule 13D/G exit filing. Watch share-placement absorption and free-float/liquidity effects.
